_comment: Rolled-up registry of every item — GENERATED by items/pipeline/sync.py from the per-item items/<id>/item.json manifests. Read this one file to load the whole catalog; paths are repo-relative. Do not hand-edit (edit config/roster.json).

MISC.label: Junk
MISC.summary: Loot dropped by monsters with no use but gold — body parts, hides, feathers, minerals, oddments. Sold at any shop.

SOUL.label: Soul Stone
SOUL.summary: A soul stone dropped by monsters. Merged into a weapon or a piece of armor to grant it the stone's power; the stone is consumed by the merge.

CONSUMABLE.label: Consumable
CONSUMABLE.summary: Used from the bag for an immediate effect — potions, elixirs, food. Consumed on use.

SWORD.label: Sword
SWORD.summary: Melee weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

BOW.label: Bow
BOW.summary: Ranged weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

WAND.label: Wand
WAND.summary: Magic weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

ARMOR.label: Armor
ARMOR.summary: Worn protection. Equipped in the armor slot; can carry merged soul powers.

items.name: Amber Root
items.description: A root that grew through amber and never quite got over it. Sap-slick, warm, and popular with alchemists.

items.name: Hawk Feather
items.description: A barred brown flight feather with a faint green sheen. Fletchers haggle; scribes simply take it and run.

items.name: Obsidian
items.description: A lump of black volcanic glass, edges keen enough to shave with. Knappers pay well and bleed often.

items.name: Black Glass
items.description: A slab of black volcanic glass, edges keen enough to shave with. Do not shave with it. People have tried.

items.name: Onyx Shard
items.description: A wedge of black volcanic glass with an edge that never dulls. Handle it with the gloves, not the confidence.

items.name: Rib Cage
items.description: A curved cage of bleached ribs, picked clean by patient things. Bone-carvers bid on it; the squeamish do not.

items.name: Sea Shells
items.description: Scallops, spirals and one cone, all bleached by salt. The tide gives them freely and the market does not.

items.name: Rift Geode
items.description: A cracked stone geode leaking cold blue light from its core. Heavy, humming, and best carried at arm's length.

items.name: Beast Tooth
items.description: A blunt ivory tooth the length of a thumb, root and all. Pulled, not dropped, which explains the smell.

items.name: Grave Dirt
items.description: A clod of graveyard soil studded with bone chips. Sold by weight, questioned by anyone who watches you dig.

items.name: Root Bundle
items.description: A fistful of pale dried roots lashed with twine; smells of cellar and regret, but alchemists pay for it anyway.

items.name: Plume Bundle
items.description: Six bright plumes lashed together with cord. Whatever wore them was loud, colourful, and no longer either.

items.name: Boar Tusk
items.description: A stout brown tusk snapped off at the root. The owner probably misses it; the owner is probably no longer around.

items.name: Bronze Knife
items.description: A short bronze blade on a worn wooden grip. Better at cutting rope and rations than at cutting heroes.

items.name: Quartz Shard
items.description: A cluster of clear quartz points catching light that is not there. Jewellers call it filler; mages call it Tuesday.

items.name: Stone Egg
items.description: An egg-shaped knot of fitted stone. Either a fossil nest or a mason's joke, and both fetch the same price.

items.name: Coiled Rope
items.description: A coil of braided hemp rope, frayed at one end where something chewed on it. Still holds a knot, mostly.

items.name: Magma Stone
items.description: A knot of cooled magma still glowing along its cracks. Warm through a glove; warmer through a bad glove.

items.name: Bone Talon
items.description: A hooked claw the length of a finger, shed by something that climbed far better than you ever will. Still sharp.

items.name: Crab Pincer
items.description: The pincer of something that walked sideways and meant it. Snaps shut on its own if you jostle it.

items.name: Curved Fang
items.description: A single curved fang, worn smooth at the tip from biting things that were, in fairness, mostly adventurers.

items.name: Bat Wing
items.description: A leathery wing of dark membrane stretched over thin bone. Flightless now, but it makes an excellent rain hood.

items.name: Oak Plank
items.description: A dense length of dark hardwood, planed flat and true. Every carpenter in Nangijala wants six more of these.

items.name: Dry Grass
items.description: Dried marsh grass bound with twine. Worth little, burns well, and every thatcher in the valley wants three.

items.name: Rune Locket
items.description: An oval bronze locket engraved with knotwork nobody can read aloud twice. It hangs heavier than its size suggests.

items.name: Ember Shard
items.description: A shard of fire-veined crystal that stays warm in the pouch. Do not store it beside anything you like.

items.name: Gilded Fang
items.description: A curved fang plated in soft gold and hollow at the root. Someone gilded a monster's tooth, and nobody asks why.

items.name: Husked Nuts
items.description: A scatter of glossy brown seeds, hard as knuckles. Roast them, plant them, or sell them to somebody less patient.

items.name: Mandrake
items.description: A gnarled root with leggy limbs and a wilted crown. It screamed when pulled, then sulked. Still worth good coin.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: Grey rock veined with bright native gold. Heavy, honest wealth, provided you can find someone to smelt it.

items.name: Amber Fang
items.description: A broad golden fang, split along the root. Something very large chewed something very hard to end up like this.

items.name: Jade Shard
items.description: A fractured sliver of green mountain glass. Holds an edge, holds a grudge, and holds its price at market.

items.name: Herb Bundle
items.description: Wild greens bound with twine, still smelling of the ditch they were pulled from. Alchemists pay; cooks pay more.

items.name: Green Slime
items.description: Still faintly quivering, and still faintly warm. Alchemists pay well for it; nobody has ever explained why.

items.name: Rock Pile
items.description: An armful of common field stones. Worth almost nothing, which has never stopped anyone from hauling them.

items.name: Sage Leaves
items.description: Grey-green leaves with a bitter herbal scent. Good in stew, better in poultices, fatal in enthusiastic quantities.

items.name: Iron Chain
items.description: Three heavy iron links from a longer chain. What it once held is not recorded, which is faintly worrying.

items.name: Hooked Wing
items.description: A leathery wing torn off at the joint. Waterproof, oddly durable, and the reason old cloaks smell like caves.

items.name: Nacre Shard
items.description: A shard of nacre swirling green and violet at every angle. Prised from a shell that objected at considerable volume.

items.name: Ivory Talon
items.description: A pale hooked talon with a scrap of its old owner still attached. Sharp enough to open letters, or throats.

items.name: Great Pearl
items.description: Prised from a shell the size of a shield. Perfectly round, faintly luminous, and worth a season of turnips.

items.name: Thread Spool
items.description: A spool of plain linen thread, half unwound. Every tailor swears they have enough and every tailor buys more.

items.name: Loose Teeth
items.description: A handful of teeth pried from something that no longer needs them. Molars, fangs, and one the alchemist won't name.

items.name: Matted Pelt
items.description: A clump of coarse black fur torn from something large and unhappy. Furriers pay well and never ask what.

items.name: Mint Slime
items.description: A quivering globule of mint-green slime that still glows faintly. Warm, oddly polite, and it will not stop wobbling.

items.name: Driftwood
items.description: A knot of sea-bleached branches, still furred with moss. Burns poorly, sells fine, and smells of low tide.

items.name: Watcher Mask
items.description: A cold steel visor with a single graven eye above the brow. It watches the shelf it sits on, which is why it sells.

items.name: Beast Molars
items.description: Two grinders pulled from something that chewed bone for a living. The town dentist pays without asking why.

items.name: Shadow Claw
items.description: A matched pair of black claws, glassy and wickedly curved. Whatever wore them did not part with them willingly.

items.name: Bone Beetle
items.description: A pale armoured beetle the size of a fist, legs still tucked in. Collectors pay well; entomologists pay better.

items.name: Pale Wing
items.description: Leather stretched over finger-bones, torn free mid-flight. Waterproof, oddly, and sold by the pair.

items.name: Frost Quartz
items.description: A cluster of pale blue crystal that keeps its chill indoors. Enchanters bid on it, drinks stay cold near it.

items.name: Rime Stones
items.description: A handful of pale hailstones that refuse to melt. Cold enough to keep a lunch fresh, dull enough to sell.

items.name: Moth Wing
items.description: Shed by something the size of a dinner plate. Still faintly dusty, still faintly unsettling to hold.

items.name: Ivory Horns
items.description: Three curved horns, pale as old ivory and ridged like bark. The beast grew them for arguments it always won.

items.name: Silk Skein
items.description: A tight coil of pale silk cord, oddly cool to the touch. Ropemakers love it, and spiders want it back.

items.name: Hornet Nest
items.description: A papery sphere with one dark doorway. Empty, the shopkeeper insists, and he is usually right about that.

items.name: Pitted Ring
items.description: A plain hammered band, worn smooth by a finger long since gone. No magic in it, but the pawnbroker won't ask.

items.name: Beast Eye
items.description: A tan eyeball, plucked out whole and still damp. It turns toward the brightest thing in the room, including you.

items.name: Iris Petals
items.description: Petals from a dusk iris, gathered past bloom. Dyers covet the colour and alchemists covet all the rest.

items.name: Venom Claw
items.description: A curved black claw with venom still crusting the point. Handle it with gloves, or you handle it exactly once.

items.name: Prism Plume
items.description: Every colour of a bird that should not exist. Fletchers bid high for it; the bird apparently wants it back.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: A thick slab of red meat, freshly cut and still dripping. Edible if cooked, tradeable if not, suspect either way.

items.name: Cloth Roll
items.description: A bolt of coarse grey canvas, rolled tight. Not glamorous, but tents and sails do not sew themselves.

items.name: Rough Stone
items.description: An unremarkable brown boulder chip. Every mason swears there is a vein inside; every mason is usually wrong.

items.name: Clawed Foot
items.description: A three-clawed foot severed at the joint. Still curls a little if you press the tendon, which nobody enjoys.

items.name: Scaled Paw
items.description: A severed paw of scaled grey hide, claws still curled inward. Sold by the pair, though rarely found that way.

items.name: River Stone
items.description: Worn smooth by a century of river water. Sells for the price of one bad lunch, but skipping stones is free.

items.name: Snow Tuft
items.description: A tuft of frost-stiffened pelt, spiky as a burr. Warm to wear, unsettling to find still twitching.

items.name: Gloom Cap
items.description: A violet cap freckled with pale spots. Edible exactly once, according to the surviving half of the herb guild.

items.name: Marrow Bone
items.description: Gnawed at both ends and stained where a bone should not be. Someone's dinner, or what was left of someone.

items.name: Rough Hide
items.description: A crudely stretched hide, still pegged at the edges. Smells of the tanner's ambition rather than his skill.

items.name: Teal Quill
items.description: A long quill shading from sea green into gold. Scribes swear it writes truer, but scribes swear many things.

items.name: Bone Bundle
items.description: A tied bundle of long pale bones, picked clean. Sold by weight and questioned by nobody at the counter.

items.name: Tooth Ridge
items.description: A slab of jaw with the teeth still socketed. The previous owner presumably misses it more than you do.

items.name: Twig Skimmer
items.description: Four glassy wings on a body like a snapped twig. Alchemists want them; nobody thought to ask the dragonfly.

items.name: Yellow Molar
items.description: A yellowed grinding tooth the size of your thumb. Whatever owned it did not chew its food at all politely.

items.name: Arcane Soul
items.description: Amethyst facets around a single pale rune. Scholars argue over what it means; the rune declines to elaborate.

soul.power: +20 arcane damage on hit and -10% spell cooldowns

items.name: Solar Soul
items.description: Banded like a beehive and lined with living gold. It warms the hand, the blade, and eventually the whole room.

soul.power: +20 radiant damage on hit and blinds undead within three tiles

items.name: Ember Soul
items.description: A cracked black shell over a furnace that never learned to go out. Warm to hold and ruinous to drop.

soul.power: +14 fire damage on hit and sets targets burning for 3s

items.name: Frost Soul
items.description: A stone of rimed slate with a pale star asleep inside. Your fingers go numb well before you notice.

soul.power: +9 frost damage and slows struck targets by 25%

items.name: Stone Soul
items.description: A brown egg heavy as a fencepost, veined with old copper. Patient, dependable and thoroughly unexciting.

soul.power: +12 armor and 15% knockback resistance

items.name: Mist Soul
items.description: A cobbled grey stone that hums faintly of wet mornings. Softens the edges of anything it is bound into.

soul.power: +8% dodge chance and attackers miss more often in dim light

items.name: Crimson Soul
items.description: Mossy stone split by a vivid red artery that pulses faintly. Best not carried in a pocket next to the heart.

soul.power: +9 damage on hit and heals you for 8% of damage dealt

items.name: Glacier Soul
items.description: Cyan light crawls the seams and the air around it turns sharp. Do not carry it in a pocket with your lunch.

soul.power: +16 frost damage on hit and slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds

items.name: Storm Soul
items.description: Dark slate cracked by rivers of cyan lightning. It hums before rain and bites anyone who argues with it.

soul.power: +15 lightning damage with a 20% chance to chain to a second target

items.name: Bark Soul
items.description: Dark grain runs through it like a felled trunk. Woodsmen swear it remembers every tree the forest ever lost.

soul.power: +8 armor and 5% of damage taken is reflected to the attacker

items.name: Patina Soul
items.description: Sea-green stone mended with seams of gold, as if some patient god glued it back together and charged for it.

soul.power: +15% gold found and +6 armor

items.name: Venom Soul
items.description: Grey rock split by sickly green light. The glow is pretty; the residue it leaves on your gloves is not.

soul.power: +13 poison damage on hit stacking up to five times

items.name: Blood Soul
items.description: A grey stone laced with veins that have not finished clotting. It beats, faintly, if you hold it too long.

soul.power: +6 damage and heals for 15% of damage dealt

items.name: Hollow Soul
items.description: Its cracks go somewhere. Drop a pebble in one and you will wait a long, disappointing while for the sound.

soul.power: +14 shadow damage on hit and ignores 10% of enemy armor

items.name: Lichen Soul
items.description: Lichen-green and quietly growing. Leave it in a drawer for a week and you will find moss on the coins beside it.

soul.power: +3 health regeneration per second

items.name: Shadow Soul
items.description: Black as a shut door, with the last coals dying inside. Light dislikes it, and the feeling is mutual.

soul.power: +14 shadow damage and 15% chance to fade from sight after a kill

items.name: Gilded Soul
items.description: Molten gold runs its cracks like spilled treasure. Merchants weep over it; smiths simply put it to work.

soul.power: +18% gold found and each critical hit drops 5 gold

items.name: Molten Soul
items.description: Molten veins crawl across a charred shell, still warm from whatever furnace spat it out. Smiths pay stupidly well.

soul.power: +22 fire damage on hit and burns the target for 4 per second

items.name: Verdant Soul
items.description: Mossed stone split by a green star. Things sprout in the pouch you keep it in, whether you asked or not.

soul.power: +10 nature damage and +2 health regeneration per second

items.name: Root Soul
items.description: Mossed over and threaded with black roots, still growing in your pack. Smells of rain and old forest floor.

soul.power: +10 nature damage on hit and regenerates 3 health per second

items.name: Bone Soul
items.description: A chalk-pale stone webbed with dry fissures. It hums like a hollow skull and steadies the bones of whoever carries it.

soul.power: +12 armor and immunity to fracture effects

items.name: Sand Soul
items.description: Sun-bleached and mild, with a faint gold heart. Desert-born, and it never quite forgets the heat.

soul.power: +8 blunt damage and attacks blind the target for 2 seconds

items.name: Granite Soul
items.description: A plain grey egg webbed with pink seams. Unglamorous, unbreakable, and heavier than it has any right to be.

soul.power: +15 armor and 10% reduced damage from falling and crushing blows

items.name: Pyre Soul
items.description: Warm to the touch, then hotter. The red veins pulse like something inside is still trying to finish burning.

soul.power: +12 fire damage on hit and burns the target for 4 per second

items.name: Rime Soul
items.description: Frost-blue and perpetually cold to the touch. Rimed veins bloom across it whenever someone nearby stops shivering.

soul.power: +10 frost damage on hit and 20% chance to slow the target

items.name: Rust Soul
items.description: Old iron gone sour, weeping copper from every slit. Whatever it holds has been rotting patiently for ages.

soul.power: +9 damage on hit and reduces the target's armor by 6 for 8 seconds

items.name: Cinder Soul
items.description: A burnt-out shell with the last red glow banked deep in its cracks. Not dead, only resting between fires.

soul.power: +4 fire damage on hit and 10% burn resistance

items.name: Void Soul
items.description: A shard of the night sky sealed in stone; hold it long enough and something out there notices you back.

soul.power: +22 void damage on hit and 10% chance to blink behind the target
